name: Agentic Health Monitoring - Static CSV Multi-Agent (No Webhook)

nodes.name: Read Health Dataset CSV
nodes.notes: Reads the user's 60,000-row synthetic patient dataset. If your project folder is elsewhere, update fileSelector. n8n file access must be allowed for the project directory.

nodes.name: Data Quality Agent
nodes.notes: Checks required fields and flags low data-accuracy scores. It does not alter the original alert labels.

nodes.name: Monitoring Agent
nodes.notes: Uses the dataset's supplied ABNORMAL labels and fall flag. Does not make a new diagnosis.

nodes.name: Clinical Summary Agent
nodes.notes: Returns one cohort summary item with alert counts and up to 25 sample records requiring review. Check the final node output after execution.
